_readme: The orgs the scheduled scan collects from, in order.
Empty is the honest default for this repository: it holds one Salesforce org,
and that org is the findings store rather than a customer estate. A workflow
that scanned it anyway would produce a number nobody asked for and call it a
cadence. .github/workflows/scan.yml therefore skips cleanly when this list is
empty, and says so, rather than failing or inventing work.
Each entry is an sf CLI alias or username the runner can authenticate as, and
the display name the scan is recorded under. `enterprise` is the tenant the
results belong to — every scan lands inside a boundary, so it is required.
